items.title: Sacred Heart Church of Ocean Beach — Free Food
items.description: Free food at Sacred Heart Church of Ocean Beach (Sacred Heart Catholic Church). Schedule: Mon–Fri 8:30 AM–4 PM (nonperishable pantry at parish office); 2nd Tue & 4th Tue from 6 PM (community dinner). Eligibility: Open to all. Call (619) 224-2746 to confirm before you go — hours change and supplies can run out. Source: community research, Sep 2026.
